entities.name: Ida of Toggenburg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ida of Toggenburg is a Swiss Christian nun, venerated as a saint in the Diocese of Constance especially in Fischingen, Switzerland. She is the protagonist of many stories and legends in the local culture.
